seasonal.title: Seasonal Forecast for November 2026 – January 2027
seasonal.text: The overall hotspot and smoke haze situation across the southern ASEAN region is expected to improve with the onset of inter-monsoon conditions. Under these conditions, the risk of transboundary haze is expected to be low. However, hotspots with localised smoke plumes may still occur under the prevailing El Niño conditions, particularly in areas where below-normal rainfall is expected. Towards the end of the year, the northern ASEAN region is expected to enter its traditional dry season, with a potential increase in hotspot and smoke haze activity, particularly in areas experiencing below-normal rainfall.
